questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers shares the same relationship in set as that shared by the numbers in the given set. (**NOTE:** Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 - Operations 13 such as adding/subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(2, 3, 5)

(5, 7, 11)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Three prime numbers are placed together.

 
• (2, 3, 5) → 2, 3, 5 are series of prime numbers

and

 
• (5, 7, 11) → 5, 7, 11 are series of prime numbers

Similarly,

 
• **(11, 13, 17) → 11, 13, 17 are series of prime numbers**

Hence, the correct answer is **"(11, 13, 17)".**

questions.question:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

8 and 4
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : 4 + 8 × 2 − 3 = 20

Given equation is : 4 + 8 × 2 − 3 = 20

After interchanging the two numbers 8 and 4 the equation is as follows : 8 + 4 × 2 - 3 = 20

⇒ 8 + __**4 × 2**__ - 3 = 20

⇒ __**8 + 8**__ - 3 = 20

⇒ __**16 - 3**__ = 20

⇒ 13 ≠ 20

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : 8 − 4 + 6 = 9

Given equation is : 8 − 4 + 6 = 9

After interchanging the two numbers 8 and 4 the equation is as follows : 4 - 8 + 6 = 9

⇒ __**4**__ - 8 __**+ 6**__ = 9

⇒ __**10**____** - 8**__ = 9

⇒ 2 ≠ 9

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 4 + 3 × 8 − 2 = 21

Given equation is : 4 + 3 × 8 − 2 = 21

After interchanging the two numbers 8 and 4 the equation is as follows : 8 + 3 × 4 - 2 = 21

⇒ 8 + __**3 × 4**__ - 2 = 21

⇒ __**8 + 12**__ - 2 = 21

⇒ __**20 - 2**__ = 21

⇒ 18 ≠ 21

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : 4 ÷ 2 + 8 × 3 = 16

Given equation is : 4 ÷ 2 + 8 × 3 = 16

After interchanging the two numbers 8 and 4 the equation is as follows : 8 ÷ 2 + 4 × 3 = 16

⇒ __**8 ÷ 2**__ + 4 × 3 = 16

⇒ 4 + __**4 × 3**__ = 16

⇒ __**4 + 12**__ = 16

⇒ **16 = 16**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"4 ÷ 2 + 8 × 3 = 16".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

64 ∶ 512 ∶∶ 81 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Second number = First number³/² 

 
• 64 ∶ 512 → 64³/² = 8³ = 512

Similarly,

 
• **81 ∶ ? → 81³/² = 9³ = 729**

Hence, the correct answer is** "729".**

questions.question: Amongst seven girls I, II, III, IV, V, VI and VII, each has a different age, VI is elder than only III. II is younger than only VII. IV is older than four other girls. I is younger than V. Who is the fourth eldest among the girls?
questions.solution:
Amongst seven girls I, II, III, IV, V, VI and VII, each has a different age,

1) VI is elder than only III.

__> __>__>__>__> VI>III

2) II is younger than only VII and IV is older than four other girls.

VII>II>IV>__>__>__>__

From 1 and 2

VII>II>IV>__>__> VI>III

3) I is younger than V.

VII>II>IV>V>I> VI>III

∴ Here, 'V' is the fourth eldest among the girls.

Hence, the correct answer is** "V".**

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

7 − 5 + 4 × 2 = 25
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : 25 and 7

Given equation is : 7 − 5 + 4 × 2 = 25

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 25 - 5 + 4 × 2 = 7

⇒ 25 - 5 + __**4 × 2**__ = 7

⇒ __**25**__ - 5 __**+ 8**__ = 7

⇒ __**33**____** - 5**__ = 7

⇒ 28 ≠ 7

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : 4 and 2

Given equation is : 7 − 5 + 4 × 2 = 25

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 7 - 5 + 2 × 4 = 25

⇒ 7 - 5 + __**2 × 4**__ = 25

⇒ __**7**__ - 5 __**+ 8**__ = 25

⇒ __**15**____** - 5**__ = 25

⇒ 10 ≠ 25

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 5 and 2

Given equation is : 7 − 5 + 4 × 2 = 25

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 7 - 2 + 4 × 5 = 25

⇒ 7 - 2 + __**4 × 5**__ = 25

⇒ __**7**__ - 2 __**+ 20**__ = 25

⇒ __**2**____**7 - 2**__ = 25

⇒ **2****5 = 25**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 4) : 7 and 5

Given equation is : 7 − 5 + 4 × 2 = 25

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 5 - 7 + 4 × 2 = 25

⇒ 5 - 7 + __**4 × 2**__ = 25

⇒ __**5**__ - 7 __**+ 8**__ = 25

⇒ __**13**____** - 7**__ = 25

⇒ 6 ≠ 25

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"5 and 2".**
